description.narrative: The project development objective is to revive livelihoods and promote recovery in the Tsunami-affected areas in the short-term and to reduce the vulnerability of coastal communities to a range of natural hazards such as cyclone, storm surge, flood and tsunami over the longer term.

Each Project State shall cause it's respective Executing Agencies to establish & maintain a financial system in accordance withconsistently applied accounting standards acceptable to the Association.
Each Project State shall maintain policies, procedures to enable it to carry out, monitor & evaluate regularly, the Projectprogress according to the indicators satisfactory to the Association
Each Project State shall prepare under the TOR acceptable to the Association, a report integrating the results of the monitoring&evaluation activities
Each Project State shall provide quarterly reports to the Association within 30 days, describing the progress achieved inimplementing the Project, in a format satisfactory to the Association
Each Project State shall provide to the Association with Technical & quality audits in respect of implementation of the Project,prepared in a format acceptable to the Association
Each Project State shall review with the Association the report referred to in para 13(b) above and take all measures forefficientcompletion of the Project.
